Post 1
🔺 ASX200 closed at 8,547 pts last week. The central question: can equities hold gains as RBA rate-cut bets get stress-tested by a fresh inflation read? Mixed stance — the rally looks stretched at these levels. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
⛏️ Mining faces a pivotal week as iron ore hovers near $95/t — any China demand signal moves the majors hard. Banks watch net interest margin pressure with the RBA on hold. Two sectors, two catalysts. #mining #ironore #banking #ASX

Post 3
One stock commanding attention: BHP. Trades near a key technical level while iron ore sits sub-$100/t. Any Chinese stimulus headline re-rates it fast. Watch volume. #ASX #mining #ironore #ausbiz

Post 4
📉 S&P500 closed near 5,600 pts. US labour data this week sets risk appetite globally. A soft print emboldens rate-cut trades; a hot one tightens financial conditions and hits ASX growth stocks hardest. #ASX #ausbiz #inflation #globalmarkets

Post 5
Calendar risk: Australian CPI print lands mid-week. Market prices one RBA cut by year-end. A surprise above 3.2% YoY kills that trade and pressures rate-sensitive stocks. Below 2.9% and property rallies hard. Which way are you positioned? #RBA #inflation #ASX #ausbiz

Post 1
5 points. That's all the ASX 200 had Monday, closing at 9,010.90. Tech shed 2.60% and dragged hard — but Energy and Materials held the floor. A near-flat close masking a market at war with itself. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
🔺 Energy +1.78%, Materials +0.42%, Financials +0.15% doing the heavy lifting. 🔻 Info Tech -2.60% the clear drag, Utilities -0.99%, Health Care -0.81% following. Breadth was negative despite the headline. #ASX #energy #ausbiz

Post 3
⛏️ Whitehaven Coal surged 7.03% to AUD 8.98 — the clearest read that energy commodity plays found buyers while growth names sold off. Coal catching a bid while tech bled tells you where conviction sat today. #ASX #coal #energy

Post 4
🪙 Gold at AUD 6,198.30/oz with AUD/USD at 0.7222. Silver AUD 92.42/oz. Platinum AUD 2,528.28/oz. Metals firm in local terms — a weaker Aussie amplifying the bid. Materials sector holding +0.42% makes sense at these levels. #gold #silver #metals #ASX

Post 5
ASX sits 3.07% below its 52-week high after a flat Monday. Can Energy and Materials absorb the Tech drag all week? Watch gold above AUD 6,000/oz as the key support signal. Bull or fade from here — what's your call? #ASX #ausbiz #gold
